the yolky eggs of accelerating species have a larger initial amount of egg material and are therefore larger than the eggs of non-accelerating species, that yolky eggs are larger in absolute size and in relative size to the mother than non-yolky eggs, and that yolky eggs have a larger reserve capacity than non-yolkiness.
